title.zh_hant: 中方嚴正關切！何立峰同貝森特視像通話　聚焦美方對華經貿限制措施
title.en: He Lifeng holds video call with Bessent and raises serious concerns over recent US trade restrictions on China
title.zh_hans: 中方严正关切！何立峰同贝森特视像通话　聚焦美方对华经贸限制措施

summary.zh_hant: 中美經貿中方牽頭人、國務院副總理何立峰，與美方牽頭人、美國財長貝森特和貿易代表格里爾，昨晚舉行視像通話，中方就近期美國對華經貿限制措施表達嚴正關切。據新華社報道，雙方圍繞落實中美元首北京和華盛頓會晤的重要共識及經貿磋商成果，就彼此關心的重要經貿問題進行了坦誠、深入和建設性的交流，同意在兩國元首戰略引領下，繼續發揮好中美經貿磋商機制的作用，持續加強合作，妥善管控分歧，推動中美經貿關係持續穩定向好發展，助力構建基於尊重、公平、對等的中美建設性戰略穩定關係。
summary.en: He Lifeng, China's lead on China-US trade and Vice-Premier of the State Council, held a video call last night with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, the US leads on trade, with Beijing raising serious concerns over recent US trade restrictions on China. According to Xinhua, the two sides discussed important trade issues of mutual concern in a candid, in-depth and constructive exchange centred on implementing the consensus reached at the Beijing and Washington meetings between the two heads of state and the outcomes of trade consultations. They agreed to keep the China-US trade consultation mechanism working well under the strategic guidance of the two leaders, continue strengthening cooperation, properly manage differences, keep China-US trade ties developing steadily and positively, and help build a constructive and strategically stable China-US relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.
summary.zh_hans: 中美经贸中方牵头人、国务院副总理何立峰，与美方牵头人、美国财长贝森特和贸易代表格里尔，昨晚举行视像通话，中方就近期美国对华经贸限制措施表达严正关切。据新华社报道，双方围绕落实中美元首北京和华盛顿会晤的重要共识及经贸磋商成果，就彼此关心的重要经贸问题进行了坦诚、深入和建设性的交流，同意在两国元首战略引领下，继续发挥好中美经贸磋商机制的作用，持续加强合作，妥善管控分歧，推动中美经贸关系持续稳定向好发展，助力构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。

title.zh_hant: 總統被捕！巴拉圭總統培尼亞遭國會彈劾罷免　副總統阿利亞納宣誓接任
title.en: Paraguay's President Pena impeached and arrested after bank collapse crisis; Vice-President Aliana sworn in as successor
title.zh_hans: 总统被捕！巴拉圭总统培尼亚遭国会弹劾罢免　副总统阿利亚纳宣誓接任

summary.zh_hant: 捲入銀行倒閉危機的巴拉圭總統培尼亞，被國會通過彈劾解除職務後被捕，警方根據檢察官的命令將他軟禁在家。副總統阿利亞納隨即宣誓接任總統，將完成培尼亞原本的餘下任期至2028年，並承諾不會拋棄失去存款的幾百萬名存戶。巴拉圭最大數字銀行韋諾銀行日前被查封接管，導致幾百萬客戶無法提取存款，引發民眾抗議；曾經是該銀行股東的培尼亞，被指控介入銀行業務，存在利益衝突、操控金融及違規使用養老基金等問題。培尼亞星期四辭職，尋求避免被彈劾，但國會當時因與會人數不足未能通過他的辭呈，及後啟動彈劾程序。根據憲法，總統若自行辭職可享有終身參議員特權，若被彈劾則失去豁免權。
summary.en: Paraguay's President Santiago Pena, embroiled in a bank collapse crisis, was arrested after Congress voted to impeach and remove him from office, with police placing him under house arrest on prosecutors' orders. Vice-President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president and will serve out the remainder of Pena's term until 2028, pledging not to abandon the millions of depositors who lost their savings. Paraguay's largest digital bank, Banco Veno, was seized and placed under administration days earlier, leaving millions of customers unable to withdraw their deposits and sparking public protests. Pena, a former shareholder of the bank, stands accused of interfering in its business, including conflicts of interest, financial manipulation and improper use of pension funds. Pena resigned on Thursday in a bid to avoid impeachment, but Congress lacked a quorum to accept his resignation and subsequently launched impeachment proceedings. Under the constitution, a president who resigns is entitled to life-senator privileges, while one who is impeached loses immunity.
summary.zh_hans: 卷入银行倒闭危机的巴拉圭总统培尼亚，被国会通过弹劾解除职务后被捕，警方根据检察官的命令将他软禁在家。副总统阿利亚纳随即宣誓接任总统，将完成培尼亚原本的余下任期至2028年，并承诺不会抛弃失去存款的几百万名存户。巴拉圭最大数字银行韦诺银行日前被查封接管，导致几百万客户无法提取存款，引发民众抗议；曾经是该银行股东的培尼亚，被指控介入银行业务，存在利益冲突、操控金融及违规使用养老基金等问题。培尼亚星期四辞职，寻求避免被弹劾，但国会当时因与会人数不足未能通过他的辞呈，及后启动弹劾程序。根据宪法，总统若自行辞职可享有终身参议员特权，若被弹劾则失去豁免权。

title.zh_hant: 選情膠著！新西蘭今日大選　拉克森爭連任　小黨或成造王者
title.en: New Zealand votes in a tight general election as Luxon seeks a second term, with minor parties likely to decide the next government
title.zh_hans: 选情胶着！新西兰今日大选　拉克森争连任　小党或成造王者

summary.zh_hant: 新西蘭今日舉行議會選舉，民調顯示國家黨領導的執政聯盟，與工黨主導的反對陣營選情膠著，預計兩大陣營都無法取得絕對多數席位，意味小黨派將在組建下屆政府的過程中發揮決定性作用。總理拉克森領導的國家黨在2023年大選中上台，今次尋求贏得第二個任期；前總理希普金斯領導的工黨則力爭重掌政權。報道指，生活成本、經濟增長、就業及公共服務等議題，是民眾最關注的議題。全國2300多個票站由當地早上9時至晚上7時開放，選舉委員會統計，截至前日已有超過166萬張選票提前發出，多於2023年選舉同一階段的137萬多張；初步結果預計在投票結束後不久出爐，正式結果本月27日公布。
summary.en: New Zealand holds a general election today, with polls showing a tight race between the governing coalition led by the National Party and the opposition bloc led by Labour, and neither side expected to win an outright majority, meaning minor parties are likely to play a decisive role in forming the next government. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, whose National Party came to power in the 2023 election, is seeking a second term, while Labour under former prime minister Chris Hipkins is bidding to return to power. Reports say the cost of living, economic growth, jobs and public services are the issues voters care about most. More than 2,300 polling stations are open from 9am to 7pm local time; the Electoral Commission says over 1.66 million advance votes had been cast by the day before yesterday, up from more than 1.37 million at the same stage in 2023. Preliminary results are expected shortly after voting closes, with official results due on November 27.
summary.zh_hans: 新西兰今日举行议会选举，民调显示国家党领导的执政联盟，与工党主导的反对阵营选情胶着，预计两大阵营都无法取得绝对多数席位，意味小党派将在组建下届政府的过程中发挥决定性作用。总理拉克森领导的国家党在2023年大选中上台，今次寻求赢得第二个任期；前总理希普金斯领导的工党则力争重掌政权。报道指，生活成本、经济增长、就业及公共服务等议题，是民众最关注的议题。全国2300多个票站由当地早上9时至晚上7时开放，选举委员会统计，截至前日已有超过166万张选票提前发出，多于2023年选举同一阶段的137万多张；初步结果预计在投票结束后不久出炉，正式结果本月27日公布。

title.zh_hant: 白宮換將！特朗普任命米勒接替懷爾斯　下周一出任幕僚長
title.en: Trump names Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff to succeed Susie Wiles from Monday
title.zh_hans: 白宫换将！特朗普任命米勒接替怀尔斯　下周一出任幕僚长

summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普宣布，現任白宮副幕僚長米勒將於當地下星期一起接替懷爾斯，出任白宮幕僚長。特朗普在社交平台宣布有關任命，形容米勒是他最信任的顧問之一，又指懷爾斯任內做得非常好，將調至他的政治團隊。懷爾斯隨後在社交平台表示，當地星期五是她任職白宮幕僚長的最後一日，雖然職責可能有變，但對總統的承諾不變。美國傳媒報道，41歲的米勒一直是特朗普核心圈的重要成員，亦是本屆政府強硬移民政策的主要制定者之一；69歲的懷爾斯長期擔任特朗普的助手，亦是首名出任白宮幕僚長的女性。懷爾斯今年較早時曾透露自己患有乳腺癌並已接受治療，之後在9月宣布已擺脫癌症，體內已無癌症跡象。
summary.en: US President Donald Trump has announced that current White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller will succeed Susie Wiles as White House Chief of Staff from Monday local time. Trump announced the appointment on social media, describing Miller as one of his most trusted advisers, and said Wiles had done an excellent job in the role and would move to his political team. Wiles said on social media afterwards that Friday local time was her last day as White House Chief of Staff, and that although her duties may change, her commitment to the president remains unchanged. US media report that Miller, 41, has long been a key member of Trump's inner circle and one of the main architects of the administration's hardline immigration policy, while Wiles, 69, has served as a longtime aide to Trump and was the first woman to hold the post of White House Chief of Staff. Wiles revealed earlier this year that she had breast cancer and received treatment, and announced in September that she was cancer-free.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普宣布，现任白宫副幕僚长米勒将于当地下星期一起接替怀尔斯，出任白宫幕僚长。特朗普在社交平台宣布有关任命，形容米勒是他最信任的顾问之一，又指怀尔斯任内做得非常好，将调至他的政治团队。怀尔斯随后在社交平台表示，当地星期五是她任职白宫幕僚长的最后一日，虽然职责可能有变，但对总统的承诺不变。美国传媒报道，41岁的米勒一直是特朗普核心圈的重要成员，亦是本届政府强硬移民政策的主要制定者之一；69岁的怀尔斯长期担任特朗普的助手，亦是首名出任白宫幕僚长的女性。怀尔斯今年较早时曾透露自己患有乳腺癌并已接受治疗，之后在9月宣布已摆脱癌症，体内已无癌症迹象。

title.zh_hant: 美元勁升穿102！美債息觸及4.9厘　市場料12月加息機會增至八成
title.en: Dollar index breaks above 102 and US 10-year yield touches 4.9% as markets price in an 80% chance of a December rate rise
title.zh_hans: 美元劲升穿102！美债息触及4.9厘　市场料12月加息机会增至八成

summary.zh_hant: 美元及美債孳息率雙雙反彈，美國上月就業數據為聯儲局加息提供空間，市場預料12月加息的機會增至約80%。白宮首席經濟顧問哈西特表示，聯儲局未來數次會議決定利率走向時，將密切關注通脹數據，以採取適當行動，他又預計通脹增速將進一步放緩。美元指數升穿102水平，創逾1星期新高，高見102.36，升逾0.8%；美國10年期債息一度升至約4.905厘，30年期債息高見5.3厘以上，兩年期債息觸及4.55厘以上。其他貨幣方面，澳元及新西蘭元兌美元跌約1%，紐約尾市分別報0.686及0.553；英鎊兌美元跌至1.334，歐元兌美元跌至1.114，美元兌日圓則升至158.5水平。
summary.en: The US dollar and Treasury yields both rebounded, with last month's US jobs data giving the Federal Reserve room to raise interest rates and markets now pricing in about an 80% chance of a hike in December. White House chief economic adviser Kevin Hassett said the Fed will watch inflation data closely when setting rates at its coming meetings so it can act appropriately, adding that he expects the pace of inflation to slow further. The dollar index broke above 102, its highest in more than a week, reaching 102.36 and rising more than 0.8%. The US 10-year yield at one point rose to about 4.905%, the 30-year yield topped 5.3% and the two-year yield touched above 4.55%. Among other currencies, the Australian and New Zealand dollars each fell about 1% against the US dollar, closing in New York at 0.686 and 0.553 respectively; sterling fell to 1.334 against the dollar, the euro to 1.114, and the dollar rose to 158.5 yen.
summary.zh_hans: 美元及美债孳息率双双反弹，美国上月就业数据为联储局加息提供空间，市场预料12月加息的机会增至约80%。白宫首席经济顾问哈西特表示，联储局未来数次会议决定利率走向时，将密切关注通胀数据，以采取适当行动，他又预计通胀增速将进一步放缓。美元指数升穿102水平，创逾1星期新高，高见102.36，升逾0.8%；美国10年期债息一度升至约4.905厘，30年期债息高见5.3厘以上，两年期债息触及4.55厘以上。其他货币方面，澳元及新西兰元兑美元跌约1%，纽约尾市分别报0.686及0.553；英镑兑美元跌至1.334，欧元兑美元跌至1.114，美元兑日圆则升至158.5水平。

title.zh_hant: 今日三區賣旗！港島、九龍、新界三機構同步籌款　社署籲提防假賣旗
title.en: Three flag days across Hong Kong today as charities sell flags in Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories; SWD warns against fake flag sellers
title.zh_hans: 今日三区卖旗！港岛、九龙、新界三机构同步筹款　社署吁提防假卖旗

summary.zh_hant: 三間慈善機構獲發公開籌款許可證，今日早上7時至中午12時半舉行賣旗：港島區由英國皇家退伍軍人協會（香港及中國分會）負責，九龍區是香港復康力量，新界區則是荃灣葵青區婦女會。社會福利署發言人表示，已安排各慈善機構協助市民分辨三個賣旗活動：港島區用白袋紅旗，九龍區用藍袋黃旗，新界區用紫紅袋白旗。慈善籌款活動的詳情已於香港政府一站通網站發布，賣旗日許可證亦已上載社署網站供參考。社署提醒市民，如懷疑遇到欺詐賣旗活動，切勿捐款並立即報警；查詢可致電社署熱線2343 2255或1823電話中心3142 2678。
summary.en: Three charities have been issued public subscription permits to hold flag sales from 7am to 12.30pm today: the Royal British Legion (Hong Kong & China Branch) on Hong Kong Island, Hong Kong Rehabilitation Power in Kowloon, and the Tsuen Wan Kwai Ching District Women's Association in the New Territories. A Social Welfare Department spokesman said arrangements have been made with the charities to help the public tell the three flag-selling activities apart: white bags and red flags on Hong Kong Island, blue bags and yellow flags in Kowloon, and magenta bags and white flags in the New Territories. Details of the charitable fund-raising activities have been published on the GovHK website, and the flag day permits have been uploaded to the SWD website for reference. The SWD reminded the public that if they suspect fraudulent flag day activities, they should not donate and should report the matter to the police immediately; enquiries can be made on the SWD hotline at 2343 2255 or the 1823 Call Centre at 3142 2678.
summary.zh_hans: 三间慈善机构获发公开筹款许可证，今日早上7时至中午12时半举行卖旗：港岛区由英国皇家退伍军人协会（香港及中国分会）负责，九龙区是香港复康力量，新界区则是荃湾葵青区妇女会。社会福利署发言人表示，已安排各慈善机构协助市民分辨三个卖旗活动：港岛区用白袋红旗，九龙区用蓝袋黄旗，新界区用紫红袋白旗。慈善筹款活动的详情已于香港政府一站通网站发布，卖旗日许可证亦已上载社署网站供参考。社署提醒市民，如怀疑遇到欺诈卖旗活动，切勿捐款并立即报警；查询可致电社署热线2343 2255或1823电话中心3142 2678。

title.zh_hant: 以色列反對派領袖稱組閣有重大進展　料下周獲授權　支持議席已過半
title.en: Israel opposition leader Eisenkot says coalition talks made significant progress and expects a mandate next week, with backers already holding a majority
title.zh_hans: 以色列反对派领袖称组阁有重大进展　料下周获授权　支持议席已过半

summary.zh_hant: 以色列國防軍前總參謀長、正直黨領導人埃森科特表示，在組建政府方面已取得顯著進展，預計下星期獲得組閣授權。現任總理內塔尼亞胡領導的陣營及埃森科特領導的反對派陣營，在日前的議會選舉中都未能取得單獨組閣所需的議席門檻；阿拉伯裔政黨聯盟日前表示會向總統赫爾佐格提議授權埃森科特組閣，目前表態支持他的政黨在議會的議席已過半數。埃森科特當地星期五在社交平台表示，將建立一個基於四項原則的政府，包括承認以色列為猶太民主國家、接納獨立宣言的價值觀、實行全民義務兵役制，以及認定哈馬斯為恐怖組織並承諾瓦解其軍事和執政能力；他計劃接觸議會各派系，吸收認同這四項原則的政黨和議員加入政府。
summary.en: Former Israel Defense Forces chief of staff and Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot said significant progress has been made in forming a government and he expects to receive the mandate to do so next week. Neither the camp of incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor Eisenkot's opposition camp won enough seats in the recent parliamentary election to form a government alone; the Arab parties' alliance said it would recommend to President Isaac Herzog that Eisenkot be given the mandate, and the parties that have declared support for him now hold more than half the seats in parliament. Eisenkot said on social media on Friday local time that he would build a government based on four principles: recognising Israel as a Jewish democratic state, accepting the values of the Declaration of Independence, introducing universal military service, and designating Hamas a terrorist organisation and pledging to dismantle its military and governing capabilities. He said he plans to approach all parliamentary factions and bring in parties and lawmakers who endorse the four principles.
summary.zh_hans: 以色列国防军前总参谋长、正直党领导人埃森科特表示，在组建政府方面已取得显著进展，预计下星期获得组阁授权。现任总理内塔尼亚胡领导的阵营及埃森科特领导的反对派阵营，在日前的议会选举中都未能取得单独组阁所需的议席门槛；阿拉伯裔政党联盟日前表示会向总统赫尔佐格提议授权埃森科特组阁，目前表态支持他的政党在议会的议席已过半数。埃森科特当地星期五在社交平台表示，将建立一个基于四项原则的政府，包括承认以色列为犹太民主国家、接纳独立宣言的价值观、实行全民义务兵役制，以及认定哈马斯为恐怖组织并承诺瓦解其军事和执政能力；他计划接触议会各派系，吸收认同这四项原则的政党和议员加入政府。

title.zh_hant: 等足一個多月！旅美大熊貓「平平」「福雙」亞特蘭大正式見客
title.en: Chinese giant pandas Pingping and Fushuang make public debut at Atlanta Zoo after more than a month of settling in
title.zh_hans: 等足一个多月！旅美大熊猫「平平」「福双」亚特兰大正式见客

summary.zh_hant: 中國旅美大熊貓「平平」及「福雙」經過一個多月的適應期後，當地星期五在美國亞特蘭大動物園大熊貓館正式亮相，與公眾見面。動物園副園長費列說，雄性大熊貓「平平」很外向、喜歡冒險，很快就適應了進食亞特蘭大的竹子，在此生活得很舒服；雌性大熊貓「福雙」比較害羞文靜，花了較多時間熟悉環境，但亦適應得很好，很喜歡這裡的竹子及蘋果。費列又說，兩隻大熊貓現時的室內活動空間是牠們以前的兩倍。
summary.en: Chinese giant pandas Pingping and Fushuang made their public debut at Zoo Atlanta on Friday local time after more than a month of settling in. The zoo's deputy director said male panda Pingping is outgoing and adventurous and quickly got used to eating Atlanta bamboo and feels comfortable there, while female panda Fushuang is shyer and quieter and took longer to get used to her surroundings, but has also adapted well and loves the local bamboo and apples. He added that the two pandas' indoor space is now twice as large as before.
summary.zh_hans: 中国旅美大熊猫「平平」及「福双」经过一个多月的适应期后，当地星期五在美国亚特兰大动物园大熊猫馆正式亮相，与公众见面。动物园副园长费列说，雄性大熊猫「平平」很外向、喜欢冒险，很快就适应了进食亚特兰大的竹子，在此生活得很舒服；雌性大熊猫「福双」比较害羞文静，花了较多时间熟悉环境，但亦适应得很好，很喜欢这里的竹子及苹果。费列又说，两只大熊猫现时的室内活动空间是它们以前的两倍。

title.zh_hant: 俄美烏下周二阿布扎比三方會談　烏方開出三大優先議題　但坦言唔指望有突破
title.en: Russia-Ukraine-US talks set for Tuesday in Abu Dhabi; Kyiv lists security guarantees, Black Sea de-escalation and an energy ceasefire as priorities but says it does not expect a breakthrough
title.zh_hans: 俄美乌下周二阿布扎比三方会谈　乌方开出三大优先议题　但坦言不指望有突破

summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯總統普京確認，下星期二在阿聯酋首都阿布扎比舉行俄美烏三方會談。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基當地星期五在社交平台表示，烏克蘭能源系統持續遭受俄羅斯無人機和導彈襲擊，烏方將繼續打擊俄羅斯煉油廠作為回應。烏克蘭外長瑟比加表示，安全保障、黑海局勢降級及能源停火等，將是烏方在三方會談中優先討論的議題，希望俄方認真對待會談；不過烏方會談代表團成員之一、總統辦公室主任布達諾夫則說，不指望三方會談取得突破。歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表卡拉斯表示，無論是烏克蘭的安全保障、戰後重建，還是對俄制裁，都繞不開歐盟，任何相關協議的落實都需要歐盟的參與。
summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has confirmed that Russia-Ukraine-US talks will be held in Abu Dhabi, capital of the United Arab Emirates, on Tuesday next week. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on social media on Friday local time that Ukraine's energy system continues to come under Russian drone and missile attacks, and Ukraine will keep striking Russian oil refineries in response. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said security guarantees, de-escalation in the Black Sea and an energy ceasefire will be Kyiv's priority issues at the talks and expressed hope that Russia will take them seriously, while Andriy Budanov, a member of the Ukrainian delegation and head of the presidential office, said he does not expect the talks to achieve a breakthrough. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said that whether it is Ukraine's security guarantees, post-war reconstruction or sanctions against Russia, none of it can bypass the EU, and the EU's involvement will be needed for any agreement to be implemented.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯总统普京确认，下星期二在阿联酋首都阿布扎比举行俄美乌三方会谈。乌克兰总统泽连斯基当地星期五在社交平台表示，乌克兰能源系统持续遭受俄罗斯无人机和导弹袭击，乌方将继续打击俄罗斯炼油厂作为回应。乌克兰外长瑟比加表示，安全保障、黑海局势降级及能源停火等，将是乌方在三方会谈中优先讨论的议题，希望俄方认真对待会谈；不过乌方会谈代表团成员之一、总统办公室主任布达诺夫则说，不指望三方会谈取得突破。欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯表示，无论是乌克兰的安全保障、战后重建，还是对俄制裁，都绕不开欧盟，任何相关协议的落实都需要欧盟的参与。

title.zh_hant: 劉海星北京會晤朝方金成男　願深化戰略溝通　促進地區和平穩定
title.en: Liu Haixing meets North Korea's Kim Song-nam in Beijing and pledges deeper strategic communication to promote regional peace and stability
title.zh_hans: 刘海星北京会晤朝方金成男　愿深化战略沟通　促进地区和平稳定

summary.zh_hant: 中共中央對外聯絡部部長劉海星在北京與朝鮮勞動黨中央政治局委員、中央書記、國際部部長金成男舉行會談。劉海星表示，中方願同朝方共同努力，堅決貫徹落實好兩黨兩國最高領導人重要共識，賡續傳統友誼、深化戰略溝通、拓展務實合作，更好造福兩國和兩國人民，促進地區和平穩定和發展繁榮；中國共產黨願同朝鮮勞動黨更加活躍展開各層級友好往來和交流，促進各領域務實合作，加強治黨治國經驗交流。金成男引述朝鮮勞動黨總書記金正恩指出，黨際關係是朝中關係的絕對優勢；朝方願同中國共產黨全面展開各層級、各領域交流，促進兩國關係進一步發展。
summary.en: Liu Haixing, head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, met in Beijing with Kim Song-nam, a member of the Political Bureau and Secretariat of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee and head of its International Department. Liu said China is ready to work with North Korea to firmly implement the important consensus reached by the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, carry forward their traditional friendship, deepen strategic communication and expand practical cooperation, so as to better benefit the two peoples and promote regional peace, stability and prosperity; the CPC is also ready to step up friendly exchanges with the WPK at all levels and in all areas, advance practical cooperation and share experience in party and state governance. Kim quoted WPK General Secretary Kim Jong Un as saying that party-to-party relations are the absolute advantage of North Korea-China relations, and said Pyongyang is ready to expand exchanges with the CPC at all levels and in all fields to further develop bilateral relations.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星在北京与朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、中央书记、国际部部长金成男举行会谈。刘海星表示，中方愿同朝方共同努力，坚决贯彻落实好两党两国最高领导人重要共识，赓续传统友谊、深化战略沟通、拓展务实合作，更好造福两国和两国人民，促进地区和平稳定和发展繁荣；中国共产党愿同朝鲜劳动党更加活跃展开各层级友好往来和交流，促进各领域务实合作，加强治党治国经验交流。金成男引述朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩指出，党际关系是朝中关系的绝对优势；朝方愿同中国共产党全面展开各层级、各领域交流，促进两国关系进一步发展。

title.zh_hant: 也門市場遇襲至少28死　胡塞指沙特空襲　也門政府反指胡塞導彈失手
title.en: At least 28 killed in attack on Yemen market; Houthis blame Saudi airstrike, government blames failed Houthi missile
title.zh_hans: 也门市场遇袭至少28死　胡塞指沙特空袭　也门政府反指胡塞导弹失手

summary.zh_hant: 也門西南部塔伊茲省一個市場星期五遇襲，至少28名平民死亡、數十人受傷。塔伊茲省地方政府發表聲明，強烈譴責襲擊，指責胡塞武裝應為事件負責；官員表示，遇襲市場位於瓦齊耶地區，事發時有數百人在市場內。胡塞武裝控制的電視台早前報道，市場遭沙特阿拉伯戰機三度空襲；也門政府控制的通訊社則報道，當日沒有戰機空襲有關市場所在的地區，反指胡塞武裝發動彈道導彈襲擊失敗導致事件。胡塞武裝近期與沙特互襲的力度增強，同時與沙特支持的也門政府軍在多條戰線的交火亦日趨激烈。
summary.en: A market in Taiz province in south-western Yemen was attacked on Friday, killing at least 28 civilians and injuring dozens. The Taiz local government issued a statement strongly condemning the attack and blaming the Houthis; officials said the market in the Al-Waziyah area had several hundred people inside at the time. Houthi-controlled television had earlier reported that the market was hit by three Saudi airstrikes, while the government-controlled news agency said there were no airstrikes in the area that day and blamed a failed Houthi ballistic missile attack instead. The Houthis have recently stepped up exchanges of fire with Saudi Arabia, and clashes with the Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces have intensified on several fronts.
summary.zh_hans: 也门西南部塔伊兹省一个市场星期五遇袭，至少28名平民死亡、数十人受伤。塔伊兹省地方政府发表声明，强烈谴责袭击，指责胡塞武装应为事件负责；官员表示，遇袭市场位于瓦齐耶地区，事发时有数百人在市场内。胡塞武装控制的电视台早前报道，市场遭沙特阿拉伯战机三度空袭；也门政府控制的通讯社则报道，当日没有战机空袭有关市场所在的地区，反指胡塞武装发动弹道导弹袭击失败导致事件。胡塞武装近期与沙特互袭的力度增强，同时与沙特支持的也门政府军在多条战线的交火亦日趋激烈。

title.zh_hant: 土耳其西部連環槍擊8死　28歲疑犯落網　據報為收割機債務糾紛
title.en: Suspect arrested after mass shooting kills eight in western Turkey; motive reportedly a debt dispute over a combine harvester
title.zh_hans: 土耳其西部连环枪击8死　28岁疑犯落网　据报为收割机债务纠纷

summary.zh_hant: 土耳其西部阿菲永卡拉希薩爾省連環槍擊案疑犯已經落網。事發在當地星期四傍晚，一名襲擊者持槍在伊赫桑尼耶區三個村莊槍殺八人後逃去，當局其後在附近的埃斯基謝希爾省抓獲一名疑犯。當地傳媒報道，疑犯是28歲收割機操作員，犯案動機源於財務糾紛，他曾向其中一名受害者借錢購買聯合收割機，雙方其後因收割機被燒毀及其他債務問題發生糾紛。疑犯供稱當日與賣家及其同伴碰面後，將他們帶至一處偏遠鄉村開槍射殺，逃走期間又企圖劫持車輛及襲擊多人，包括兩名女教師。
summary.en: A suspect has been arrested in the mass shooting in Afyonkarahisar province in western Turkey. On Thursday evening local time, an attacker shot dead eight people in three villages in the Ihsaniye district before fleeing; police later caught a suspect in the nearby Eskisehir province. Local media reported the suspect is a 28-year-old combine harvester operator and the motive was a financial dispute: he had borrowed money from one of the victims to buy a combine harvester, and the two later fell out over the harvester being burned and other debts. The suspect told police he met the seller and his companions that day, took them to a remote village and shot them, and while fleeing tried to hijack a vehicle and attacked several other people, including two female teachers.
summary.zh_hans: 土耳其西部阿菲永卡拉希萨尔省连环枪击案疑犯已经落网。事发在当地星期四傍晚，一名袭击者持枪在伊赫桑尼耶区三个村庄枪杀八人后逃去，当局其后在附近的埃斯基谢希尔省抓获一名疑犯。当地传媒报道，疑犯是28岁收割机操作员，犯案动机源于财务纠纷，他曾向其中一名受害者借钱购买联合收割机，双方其后因收割机被烧毁及其他债务问题发生纠纷。疑犯供称当日与卖家及其同伴碰面后，将他们带至一处偏远乡村开枪射杀，逃走期间又企图劫持车辆及袭击多人，包括两名女教师。

title.zh_hant: 比利時國王拒收首相辭呈　勒令即刻重開預算談判　五黨聯盟僵局待解
title.en: Belgium's King Philippe refuses prime minister's resignation and orders budget talks to resume immediately
title.zh_hans: 比利时国王拒收首相辞呈　勒令即刻重开预算谈判　五党联盟僵局待解

summary.zh_hant: 比利時國王菲利普拒絕接受首相德韋弗的辭呈，並要求他立即恢復預算談判。德韋弗領導的五黨聯合政府連月來就2027年聯邦預算及到2029年實現約100億歐元財政調整目標進行談判，但各黨分歧明顯，未能達成協議，德韋弗星期一因談判失敗向國王遞交辭呈。王宮表示，菲利普當地星期五接見德韋弗，指出與執政聯盟五個政黨的主席會面後，各方均承諾願意讓步，以促成協議。菲利普強調，必須在維護社會凝聚力與促進經濟增長之間保持良好平衡。德韋弗將於本月16日再向國王匯報進展，他日前表示，希望達成一項能夠確保未來幾年財政穩定的預算協議。
summary.en: Belgium's King Philippe has refused to accept Prime Minister Bart De Wever's resignation and asked him to resume budget negotiations immediately. De Wever's five-party coalition government has spent months negotiating the 2027 federal budget and a fiscal adjustment of about 10 billion euros by 2029, but the parties remain sharply divided and no agreement has been reached; De Wever submitted his resignation to the King on Monday after the talks failed. The palace said Philippe met De Wever on Friday and, having met the chairs of the five coalition parties, found all sides had promised to make concessions to reach a deal within the coalition. Philippe stressed the need to strike a good balance between preserving social cohesion and promoting economic growth. De Wever will report back to the King on November 16; he has said he hopes to reach a budget agreement that will ensure fiscal stability in the coming years.
summary.zh_hans: 比利时国王菲利普拒绝接受首相德韦弗的辞呈，并要求他立即恢复预算谈判。德韦弗领导的五党联合政府连月来就2027年联邦预算及到2029年实现约100亿欧元财政调整目标进行谈判，但各党分歧明显，未能达成协议，德韦弗星期一因谈判失败向国王递交辞呈。王宫表示，菲利普当地星期五接见德韦弗，指出与执政联盟五个政党的主席会面后，各方均承诺愿意让步，以促成协议。菲利普强调，必须在维护社会凝聚力与促进经济增长之间保持良好平衡。德韦弗将于本月16日再向国王汇报进展，他日前表示，希望达成一项能够确保未来几年财政稳定的预算协议。

title.zh_hant: 元朗白沙村深夜三級火　消防三喉三煙帽隊灌救　暫無人傷亡
title.en: No. 3 alarm fire in Yuen Long's Pak Sha Tsuen; firefighters battle blaze with three jets, no casualties reported
title.zh_hans: 元朗白沙村深夜三级火　消防三喉三烟帽队灌救　暂无人伤亡

summary.zh_hant: 元朗白沙村昨晚近11時發生火警，晚上11時25分升為三級火。消防處出動三條消防喉及三隊煙帽隊灌救，火勢仍在撲救中。事件暫時未接獲傷亡報告，起火原因有待調查。
summary.en: A fire broke out at Pak Sha Tsuen in Yuen Long at about 10:58pm yesterday and was upgraded to a No. 3 alarm at 11:25pm. Firefighters are using three jets and three breathing apparatus teams to fight the blaze. No casualties have been reported so far, and the cause of the fire is under investigation.
summary.zh_hans: 元朗白沙村昨晚近11时发生火警，晚上11时25分升为三级火。消防处出动三条消防喉及三队烟帽队灌救，火势仍在扑救中。事件暂时未接获伤亡报告，起火原因有待调查。

title.zh_hant: 立法會強烈譴責外部勢力抹黑黃之鋒案判刑　斥雙重標準　要求放人先係破壞法治
title.en: LegCo strongly condemns external forces for smearing court sentencing in Wong Chi-fung case, calling it double standards
title.zh_hans: 立法会强烈谴责外部势力抹黑黄之锋案判刑　斥双重标准　要求放人先是破坏法治

summary.zh_hant: 立法會強烈譴責和反對外部勢力詆毀和抹黑法庭就黃之鋒「串謀勾結外國或境外勢力危害國家安全罪」作出的判刑。發言人表示，多個美西方國家、反華媒體、境外組織及政客近日藉判刑發表失實言論，詆毀香港司法制度及國家安全法律，妄圖將黃之鋒損害國家和香港利益的犯罪行為歪曲為個人政治表達，完全是政治操弄。發言人指出，法庭已指出黃之鋒及羅冠聰為案件主謀，在《香港國安法》實施前後持續勾結外國勢力、要求制裁；《香港國安法》不具追溯力，黃之鋒並非因實施前的行為或政治理念受罰，他已承認控罪及相關案情。發言人又說，部分外部勢力要求無條件釋放黃之鋒並撤銷控罪，才是嚴重破壞法治；美西方國家長期以人權和自由為藉口干預香港事務，雙重標準完全不能接受。發言人亦提到，香港自《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》實施後恢復穩定繁榮，第三季本地生產總值按年增長估計達5.2%，全球競爭力排名升至第二，國際調解院總部已在港設立。
summary.en: The Legislative Council strongly condemned and opposed external forces smearing the court's sentencing of Wong Chi-fung for "conspiracy to collude with a foreign country or with external elements to endanger national security". A spokesman said several Western countries, anti-China media, overseas organisations and politicians had recently made false statements about the sentencing, smearing Hong Kong's judicial system and national security laws and distorting Wong's crimes harming national and Hong Kong interests as personal political expression — pure political manipulation. The spokesman noted the court had found Wong Chi-fung and Law Kwun-chung were the masterminds of the case, persistently colluding with foreign forces and soliciting sanctions before and after the Hong Kong National Security Law took effect; the law has no retrospective effect, and Wong was not punished for acts or political beliefs before its implementation — he has pleaded guilty to the charge and the relevant facts. The spokesman said external forces demanding Wong's unconditional release and the dropping of charges were the ones seriously undermining the rule of law, and that Western countries' long-standing use of human rights and freedom as a pretext to interfere in Hong Kong affairs showed double standards that were completely unacceptable. He added that Hong Kong has restored stability and prosperity since the national security law and the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance took effect, with third-quarter GDP estimated to have grown 5.2 per cent year on year, global competitiveness ranking rising to second, and the International Organization for Mediation headquartered in Hong Kong.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会强烈谴责和反对外部势力诋毁和抹黑法庭就黄之锋「串谋勾结外国或境外势力危害国家安全罪」作出的判刑。发言人表示，多个美西方国家、反华媒体、境外组织及政客近日借判刑发表失实言论，诋毁香港司法制度及国家安全法律，妄图将黄之锋损害国家和香港利益的犯罪行为歪曲为个人政治表达，完全是政治操弄。发言人指出，法庭已指出黄之锋及罗冠聪为案件主谋，在《香港国安法》实施前后持续勾结外国势力、要求制裁；《香港国安法》不具追溯力，黄之锋并非因实施前的行为或政治理念受罚，他已承认控罪及相关案情。发言人又说，部分外部势力要求无条件释放黄之锋并撤销控罪，才是严重破坏法治；美西方国家长期以人权和自由为借口干预香港事务，双重标准完全不能接受。发言人亦提到，香港自《香港国安法》及《维护国家安全条例》实施后恢复稳定繁荣，第三季本地生产总值按年增长估计达5.2%，全球竞争力排名升至第二，国际调解院总部已在港设立。

title.zh_hant: 美股初段個別發展　晶片股強勁反彈　費半升逾6%　美光飆近10%
title.en: US stocks mixed in early trading as chip stocks rebound sharply; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up over 6%
title.zh_hans: 美股初段个别发展　芯片股强劲反弹　费半升逾6%　美光飙近10%

summary.zh_hant: 美股在開市初段個別發展，晶片股反彈。道瓊斯指數較早時報51272點，跌250點，跌幅0.49%；納斯達克指數報24703點，升388點，升幅1.6%；標準普爾500指數報7408點，升54點，升幅0.74%。費城半導體指數升逾6%，其中美光科技升近10%，英特爾升逾8%，Nvidia升近7%。
summary.en: US stocks were mixed in early trading as chip stocks rebounded. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was earlier at 51,272, down 250 points or 0.49 per cent; the Nasdaq was at 24,703, up 388 points or 1.6 per cent; and the S&P 500 was at 7,408, up 54 points or 0.74 per cent. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose more than 6 per cent, with Micron up nearly 10 per cent, Intel up more than 8 per cent and Nvidia up nearly 7 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 美股在开市初段个别发展，芯片股反弹。道琼斯指数较早时报51272点，跌250点，跌幅0.49%；纳斯达克指数报24703点，升388点，升幅1.6%；标准普尔500指数报7408点，升54点，升幅0.74%。费城半导体指数升逾6%，其中美光科技升近10%，英特尔升逾8%，Nvidia升近7%。

title.zh_hant: 美國11月消費信心初值51　高過預期　1年通脹預期4.3%
title.en: US November consumer confidence preliminary reading at 51, above expectations; one-year inflation expectations at 4.3%
title.zh_hans: 美国11月消费信心初值51　高过预期　1年通胀预期4.3%

summary.zh_hant: 美國密歇根大學11月美國消費者信心指數初值為51，高過市場預期的48。期內，消費者現況指數初值為51，預期指數初值為50.9，分別高過預期的48和49.5。消費者1年通脹預期初值為4.3%，5年通脹預期初值為3.4%。
summary.en: The University of Michigan's preliminary November US consumer confidence index came in at 51, above the market expectation of 48. The current conditions index was 51 and the expectations index was 50.9, both above expectations of 48 and 49.5 respectively. Consumers' one-year inflation expectations were 4.3 per cent, and five-year expectations were 3.4 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 美国密歇根大学11月美国消费者信心指数初值为51，高过市场预期的48。期内，消费者现况指数初值为51，预期指数初值为50.9，分别高过预期的48和49.5。消费者1年通胀预期初值为4.3%，5年通胀预期初值为3.4%。

title.zh_hant: 澳洲太陽能玻璃公司落戶香港　設全球研發基地搶大灣區　發電玻璃外牆供電
title.en: Australian solar glass firm ClearVue sets up global R&D base in Hong Kong to target Greater Bay Area
title.zh_hans: 澳洲太阳能玻璃公司落户香港　设全球研发基地抢大湾区　发电玻璃外墙供电

summary.zh_hant: 投資推廣署宣布，澳洲清潔技術公司 ClearVue 已在香港設立全球研發基地，應付亞洲日益增長的項目管理及業務發展需要，策略重點為粵港澳大灣區。ClearVue 將建築外牆吸收的太陽能轉化為可再生能源，專利太陽能玻璃在保持透明度及建築美學的同時發電。在投資推廣署支持下，ClearVue 早前已與內地真空玻璃製造商洛陽蘭迪鈦金屬真空玻璃成立合資公司，結合專利太陽能玻璃技術與內地製造優勢，生產具成本效益、可發電的建築玻璃。投資推廣署署理署長劉凱旋表示歡迎，形容香港高樓林立，是將玻璃外牆變成潔淨發電機的理想試驗場；ClearVue 行政總裁 Doug Hunt 表示，將繼續投資香港人才及基建，以香港作為進軍亞太的戰略門戶。
summary.en: Invest Hong Kong announced that Australian clean technology company ClearVue Technologies has established a new global research and development base in Hong Kong to address growing project management and business development needs in Asia, with a strategic focus on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. ClearVue converts solar energy absorbed by building facades into renewable energy, and its patented solar glass generates electricity while preserving transparency and building aesthetics. With Invest Hong Kong's support, ClearVue has previously formed a joint venture in Hong Kong with Mainland vacuum-glass manufacturer Luoyang Landvac Ti-Vig, combining its patented solar glass technology with Mainland manufacturing strengths to produce cost-effective, energy-generating building glass. Acting Director-General of Investment Promotion Arnold Lau welcomed the move, describing Hong Kong's high-rises as an ideal proving ground for technology that turns glass facades into clean power generators; ClearVue Chief Executive Doug Hunt said the company will continue investing in Hong Kong talent and infrastructure and use the city as a strategic gateway for expansion across Asia Pacific.
summary.zh_hans: 投资推广署宣布，澳洲清洁技术公司 ClearVue 已在香港设立全球研发基地，应付亚洲日益增长的项目管理及业务发展需要，策略重点为粤港澳大湾区。ClearVue 将建筑外墙吸收的太阳能转化为可再生能源，专利太阳能玻璃在保持透明度及建筑美学的同时发电。在投资推广署支持下，ClearVue 早前已与内地真空玻璃制造商洛阳兰迪钛金属真空玻璃成立合资公司，结合专利太阳能玻璃技术与内地制造优势，生产具成本效益、可发电的建筑玻璃。投资推广署署理署长刘凯旋表示欢迎，形容香港高楼林立，是将玻璃外墙变成洁净发电机的理想试验场；ClearVue 行政总裁 Doug Hunt 表示，将继续投资香港人才及基建，以香港作为进军亚太的战略门户。
